Claim collection

API for collecting claims.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Clame/Clame_Xml.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code
2. Required shoplinker_id string Shoplinker account
3. Required st_date string Claim start date yyyymmdd
4. Required ed_date string Claim end date yyyymmdd
5. sdt_time string Query start time hhiiss Query start time
6. edt_time string Query end time hhiiss Query end time
7. claim_type string Claim type Allowed values
  1. - All : null
  2. - Automatic : 001
  3. - Manual : 002
8. order_id string Marketplace order number
9. id string Shoplinker order number
10. delivery_claim_status string Claim status Allowed values
  1. - Cancellation requested : 011
  2. - Return requested : 006
  3. - Exchange requested : 004
 If NULL, all claim orders are shown

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ClameInfo>
		<customer_id>고객사코드</customer_id>
		<shoplinker_id>42917246</shoplinker_id>
		<st_date>20110709</st_date>
		<ed_date>20110711</ed_date>
	</ClameInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. shoplinker_order_id string Shoplinker order number
2. mall_order_id string Marketplace order number
3. mall_name string Marketplace name
4. order_product_id string Ordered product number
5. shoplinker_product_id string Shoplinker product code
6. product_name string Product name
7. quantity string Total order quantity
8. order_price string Total order amount
9. sku string Option name
10. clame_status string Claim status
11. clame_type string Claim category Allowed values
  1. - Cancellation-related : 001
  2. - Exchange-related : 002
  3. - Return-related : 003
  4. - Other : 004
12. clame_memo string Claim memo
13. clame_date string Claim date
14. mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code APISHOP_0003
15. claim_type Claim type Allowed values
  1. - All : null
  2. - Automatic : 001
  3. - Manual : 002
16. delivery_invoice string Waybill number
